description: Declares a constant whose `[Symbol.dispose]()` runs automatically when the enclosing block exits.
Like `using`, but awaits `[Symbol.asyncDispose]()`. Only inside async functions or module top level.
Interfaces for objects with `[Symbol.dispose]()` or `[Symbol.asyncDispose]()` cleanup methods.
Resources are released in reverse order of declaration, even when an exception leaves the block.
A container that collects disposables, callbacks (`defer`) and adopted values, and disposes them together.
Thrown when disposal fails while another error is already propagating; keeps both errors.
